name: AFlow (Automating Agentic Workflow Generation)
org: DeepWisdom, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
one_liner: Monte Carlo Tree Search over code-represented workflows iteratively mutates and evaluates multi-agent pipelines.

loop.proposes: An LLM mutates a selected workflow node by adding, removing, or rewiring prompt and tool operators in Python code.
loop.judged_by: A benchmark execution engine runs the modified workflow on the validation split and records empirical score and execution trace.
loop.steers: MCTS backpropagates validation scores up the workflow tree and selects the next node by soft mixed-probability selection.

headline_result: Outperforms hand-crafted and automated workflow baselines by 5.7% average across six coding and math benchmarks while enabling smaller models to beat GPT-4o.
caveat: Workflow search requires dozens of validation evaluations per benchmark, and overfits if the validation slice is too small.
beyond_harness_note: MCTS controls the search over code graphs, calling the LLM as a mutation operator and keeping the top-scoring workflow program.
algorithmic_authority: Monte Carlo Tree Search and benchmark execution evaluator

sources.title: AFlow: Automating Agentic Workflow Generation (ICLR 2025 / arXiv:2410.10762)

verification.notes: Checked against Zhang et al., arXiv:2410.10762.
